sql: SELECT DISTINCT "Region" FROM radiocarbon_database_regional ORDER BY "Region"
SELECT "Region", "Site", "Culture", "Material", "date", "error", "Cal. BC 1 sigma", "Cal. BC 2 sigma" FROM radiocarbon_database_regional WHERE "Region" = 'Malta' ORDER BY "date" LIMIT 50
SELECT MIN("Age_ky") AS min_age, MAX("Age_ky") AS max_age, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT("K") AS n_k, MIN("K") AS min_k, MAX("K") AS max_k FROM climateMeasurements

WITH target AS ( SELECT 6.005 AS t_age UNION ALL SELECT 6.412 ), k AS ( SELECT "Age_ky" AS age, "K" AS k FROM climateMeasurements WHERE "Age_ky" IS NOT NULL AND "K" IS NOT NULL ), below AS ( SELECT t.t_age, MAX(k.age) AS age_below FROM target t JOIN k ON k.age <= t.t_age GROUP BY t.t_age ), above AS ( SELECT t.t_age, MIN(k.age) AS age_above FROM target t JOIN k ON k.age >= t.t_age GROUP BY t.t_age ) SELECT b.t_age, b.age_below, kb.k AS k_below, a.age_above, ka.k AS k_above FROM below b JOIN above a ON a.t_age = b.t_age JOIN k kb ON kb.age = b.age_below JOIN k ka ON ka.age = a.age_above ORDER BY b.t_age

WITH k AS ( SELECT "Age_ky" AS age, "K" AS k FROM climateMeasurements WHERE "Age_ky" IS NOT NULL AND "K" IS NOT NULL ), target AS ( SELECT 6.412 AS t_age UNION ALL SELECT 6.005 ), interp AS ( SELECT t.t_age, b.age AS age_below, b.k AS k_below, a.age AS age_above, a.k AS k_above, b.k + (a.k - b.k) * (t.t_age - b.age) / (a.age - b.age) AS k_interp FROM target t JOIN (SELECT t2.t_age AS t_age, MAX(k2.age) AS age FROM target t2 JOIN k k2 ON k2.age <= t2.t_age GROUP BY t2.t_age) bl ON bl.t_age = t.t_age JOIN (SELECT t2.t_age AS t_age, MIN(k2.age) AS age FROM target t2 JOIN k k2 ON k2.age >= t2.t_age GROUP BY t2.t_age) ab ON ab.t_age = t.t_age JOIN k b ON b.age = bl.age JOIN k a ON a.age = ab.age ) SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN t_age = 6.412 THEN k_interp END), 4) AS k_first_6412, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN t_age = 6.005 THEN k_interp END), 4) AS k_last_6005, ROUND(AVG(k_interp), 4) AS avg_potassium_ppm FROM interp

WITH malta AS ( SELECT MIN("date") AS earliest_bp, MAX("date") AS latest_bp, COUNT(*) AS n_records FROM radiocarbon_database_regional WHERE "Region" = 'Malta' ), k AS ( SELECT "Age_ky" AS age, "K" AS k FROM climateMeasurements WHERE "Age_ky" IS NOT NULL AND "K" IS NOT NULL ), target AS ( SELECT 6.412 AS t_age, 'first_recorded' AS label UNION ALL SELECT 6.005, 'last_recorded' ), b AS (SELECT t.t_age, t.label, MAX(k.age) AS age_below FROM target t JOIN k ON k.age <= t.t_age GROUP BY 1,2), a AS (SELECT t.t_age, t.label, MIN(k.age) AS age_above FROM target t JOIN k ON k.age >= t.t_age GROUP BY 1,2), p AS ( SELECT b.t_age, b.label, b.age_below, a.age_above, kb.k AS k_below, ka.k AS k_above, kb.k + (ka.k - kb.k) * (b.t_age - b.age_below) / (a.age_above - b.age_below) AS k_interp FROM b JOIN a ON a.t_age = b.t_age JOIN k kb ON kb.age = b.age_below JOIN k ka ON ka.age = a.age_above ) SELECT m.earliest_bp, m.latest_bp, m.n_records, p.t_age, p.label, p.age_below, p.k_below, p.age_above, p.k_above, (p.age_below <= p.t_age AND p.t_age <= p.age_above) AS straddles_valid, ROUND(p.k_interp, 4) AS k_interp_ppm FROM malta m CROSS JOIN p ORDER BY p.t_age
